{{Short description|Brazilian mathematician}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=April 2024}}
'''Djairo Guedes de Figueiredo''' (academic signature: '''D. G. De Figueiredo''', born on 2 April 1934, in [[Limoeiro do Norte]]) is a Brazilian [[mathematician]] noted for his research on [[differential equation]]s, [[elliptic operator]]s, and [[calculus of variations]].<ref name="archive.org">{{cite web|url=http://www.abc.org.br/~djairo|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20150518051223/http://www.abc.org.br/~djairo|archivedate=2015-05-18|title=Academia Brasileira de Ciências|date=18 May 2015|publisher=|accessdate=31 August 2018}}</ref> He is considered the greatest [[mathematical analysis|analyst]] from Brazil.<ref>Clóvis Pereira da Silva, ''Aspectos históricos do desenvolvimento da pesquisa matemática no Brasil'', page 39, [https://books.google.com/books?id=7hpr_qVq-i4C&pg=PA39 Google books quick-link]</ref> He was the president of the [[Sociedade Brasileira de Matemática|Brazilian Mathematical Society]] from 1977 to 1979.<ref>{{cite web | url=http://www.sbm.org.br/institucional/quem-somos/memória/diretorias | title=Diretorias Anteriores – SBM – Sociedade Brasileira de Matemática }}</ref>

Figueiredo is a well-known figure among mathematicians in analysis and differential equations and among Brazilian students in physics, engineering and mathematics. He has received many Brazilian national and international prizes, both for his research in pure mathematics and also for his popular mathematics [[textbook]]s (about [[Mathematical analysis|analysis]] and [[differential equation]]s) and expository writing papers. In 1995 he received the [[National Order of Scientific Merit]]<ref name="archive.org"/> and in 2004 the title of "[[Honoris causa|Doctor Honoris Causa]]" from the [[Federal University of Paraíba]]. 

In 2009, he became a member of the National Academy of Science of Buenos Aires. In 2011, he became the first Brazilian to receive a gold medal from the [[Telesio-Galilei Academy of Sciences]] "for his great contribution to Mathematics, especially to the theory of elliptical partial differential equations".<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.telesio-galilei.com/tg/index.php/academy-award-2011|title=Telesio Galilei Academy Award 2011|last=Administrator|website=www.telesio-galilei.com|accessdate=31 August 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180220102644/http://www.telesio-galilei.com/tg/index.php/academy-award-2011|archive-date=2018-02-20|url-status=live}}</ref>

He was a Ph.D. student of [[Louis Nirenberg]] at [[New York University]],<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=33509|title=Djairo Guedes de Figueiredo}}</ref> and is currently a titular professor at [[UNICAMP]], a position he began in 1988.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.escavador.com/sobre/3814162/djairo-guedes-de-figueiredo|title=Djairo Guedes de Figueiredo|work=Escavador|access-date=2024-05-17}}</ref>

He is a recipient of [[National Order of Scientific Merit (Brazil)|Brazil's National Order of Scientific Merit]] in mathematics (1995).<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.mct.gov.br/index.php/content/view/11199/11199.html?nome=&area=Ci%EAncias+Matem%E1ticas&classificacao=&categoria=vivo |title=Portal do Ministério da Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação |access-date=2016-03-01 |archive-url=https://archive.today/20150418134045/http://www.mct.gov.br/index.php/content/view/11199/11199.html?nome=&area=Ci%EAncias+Matem%E1ticas&classificacao=&categoria=vivo |archive-date=2015-04-18 |url-status=dead }}</ref> Since 1969 he has been a member of the [[Brazilian Academy of Sciences]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.abc.org.br/~djairo |title=Academia Brasileira de Ciências |accessdate=2015-05-18 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20150518051223/http://www.abc.org.br/~djairo |archivedate=2015-05-18 }}</ref>

== Selected papers ==
*D. G. de Figueiredo, [[Pierre-Louis Lions|P. L. Lions]], R. D. Nussbaum. "A priori estimates and existence of positive solutions of semilinear elliptic equations", ''[[Journal de Mathématiques Pures et Appliquées]]'', 61, 1982, pp.&nbsp;41–63.
*D. G. de Figueiredo, P. L. Felmer . "On superquadratic elliptic systems", ''[[Transactions of the American Mathematical Society]]'', v. 343, n. 1, 1994, pp.&nbsp;99–116.
*P. Clément, D. G. de Figueiredo, E. Mitidieri . "Positive solutions of semilinear elliptic systems", ''Communications in Partial Differential Equations'', v. 17, n. 5–6., 1992, pp.&nbsp;923–940.
*D. G. de Figueiredo, E. Mitidieri . A Maximum Principle for an Elliptic System and Applications to Semilinear Problems, ''SIAM Journal on Mathematical Analysis'', v. 17, n. 4, 1986, pp.&nbsp;836-849.


  
The book ''Selected Papers of Djairo Guedes Figueiredo'' has been published by Springer, as part of the collection ''Selected Works of Outstanding Brazilian Mathematicians'' ([https://books.google.com/books?id=ZTrBBAAAQBAJ Google Preview]).

== Books ==
*''Análise I'' (1975, in Portuguese)
*''Análise de Fourier e Equações Diferenciais Parciais'' (1977, in Portuguese)
*''Equações Diferenciais Aplicadas'' (1979, in Portuguese)
*''Números Irracionais e Transcendentes'' (1974, in Portuguese)
*''Equações Elípticas não Lineares'' (1977, in Portuguese)
*''Lectures on the Ekeland Variational Principle with Applications and Detours'' (Springer Verlag, 1989)
